Japan Surveillance Drone Likely Crashed Off Coast

Japan's Self-Defense Force (ASDF) believes its surveillance drone likely crashed off the northwestern coast of the country. Debris spotted and photographed floating in waters off the Tottori prefecture is believed to be from the drone. The exact cause and circumstances of the suspected crash are not yet detailed.
